title: Implement the Runtime-owned dormant launcher provisioning API
description: Named next Runtime component phase for existing TASK-conversation-persistent-operations under owner08/current resume. Runtime2b4834f5 declined Release edits and offered an unimplemented API; Runtime is actual implementer, Kernel supplies pure inventory contract, Release consumes exact qualified export, QA owns truth/contributor consent. Sequence after Runtime's active unread-first task and Kernel inventory component; no second active Runtime assignment. Proposed narrow Runtime primary source src/schedules/dormant-plan.mjs (live ownership verified), with any additional launcher-path edits explicitly mapped/reviewed before code. First pin exact export/input/output/version/digest and dormant reconciliation effect boundary with Release/Kernel/QA. Implement pure declarative disabled-unit/dormant provisioning/reconciliation plan from validated inventory and supplied observed evidence; any fixture-only apply adapter must be separately explicit, hermetic and consented. No host actions, systemctl/linger/enable/start, provider launches/wakes, manifest/config ownership edits, DB initialization/recovery, installation switch or process/fence inference. Preserve blocked starting-presence task and old guard/receipt evidence. Independent source qualification and guarded landing precede Release consumption.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime, Kernel, Release and QA pin an actual versioned export, exact owned source/test paths and named contributor permission; no Release editing Runtime paths or consuming a merely proposed export.

Validated inventory and explicit observed-state inputs produce deterministic digest-bound dormant plans retaining declared lifetime/timezone/budget/restart/missed-run/pause and exact owned unit metadata, with every unit disabled and no operational/activation claim.

Repeated install/restore/upgrade planning is idempotent; unknown units, user edits, ownership/drift, unsupported destinations or stale source/config/artifact digests are preserved or explicitly blocked, never blindly overwritten/removed/adopted.

Planning/import has no filesystem/manifest/DB/process/systemctl/provider effects; disabled state cannot imply wake scheduling, active service, catchup permission or a trusted writer fence. Any fixture-only apply adapter remains hermetic and visibly isolated, without operational receipt promotion.

QA strict additive scenarios use temp home/project, fake systemctl and fixed clock/timezone; demonstrate no effects, dormant state, idempotence, preserved drift and explicit policy/no implicit catchup, with a Test Integrity Note and no weaker existing tests.

Runtime hands actual implemented candidate/export/version to Release after independent exact-source checks and QA acceptance/serialized guarded integration; record genuine incompatible-engine/schema/tool refusals rather than unqualified landing, fixture PASS promotion or host activation.
milestone: After unread-first reliability and pure inventory API
